hero.title: Mia — Voice Task App
hero.subtitle: Speak tasks. See your day.
hero.tagline: A Flutter productivity shell with voice intents, AI enrichment, theme packs, and a multi-source Calendar — plus companion Chrome extensions for tasks and invites.
hero.impact: Voice is the differentiator — AssemblyAI + Gemini turn speech into structured tasks and calendar events. Firestore keeps the guest agenda in sync with Mia Task Capture and Mia Calendar Capture.

problems.d: Typing every task breaks flow — voice and browser capture should create structured work in one pass.
Tasks, calendar, and themes need clear boundaries without becoming separate apps.
Useful agendas should work from manual entry, voice, and extension capture — not only Google sync.
Invites and task snippets live in the browser; they need to land in the same Firestore store the app reads.
